parameters.text:
🤖 *CareerForge — Command Guide*

*Job Search*
• `find jobs` — search 10 companies for AI/ML roles
• `find jobs in San Francisco` — filter by city
• `find remote jobs` — remote-only filter

*Applications*
• `[number]` — apply to job #N from last search
• `apply to job 3` — generate resume + cover letter

*Company Intel*
• `tell me about Anthropic` — news, funding, visa history
• `research OpenAI` — full company brief + outreach draft

*Interview Prep*
• `interview prep for Stripe` — 20 questions + STAR answers
• `practice questions for ML engineer` — role-specific prep

*Salary Coach*
• `salary help` — negotiation script + scenarios
• `counter offer advice` — equity + base strategy

*Preferences*
• `set my location to NYC` — saved for all future searches
• `I need H-1B sponsorship` — filters visa-friendly companies
• `set salary min to 180000` — filters below-range roles

*Tracker*
• `show my applications` — full application history
• `application status` — status by company

_Powered by CareerForge Nexus • Sprint 3_
